notes.title: Small update 0.25.1
notes.content:
I have just released a very small update.
I have corrected a few sentences in English.
I am continuing to work on the final release of the game, and already now I can guarantee its release by mid-June.
The game will continue to remain in early access throughout the summer, until I am sure that everything is working properly.
I attach a screenshot of the final release.
Thank you.

notes.title: Darkness Revenge New update released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42832659/f1cadc22fa520c5f41a378601e8ddcf38b35b3db.jpg[/img]

The penultimate major update of Darkness Revenge is now available!
Darkness Revenge reaches and exceeds 86,000 words with 675 possible choices and over 4000 pictures.

Changelog:
- 600 new images
- 12 new animations
- 10000 words of dialogue
- Several new plot choices
- A multitude of sex scenes (all with Jill)
- 7 new achievements
- Modified Nathan's narration
- Bug fixes

As always, as the game is still in early access, I invite all players to report any plot inconsistencies or programming errors.
Thank you all!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42832659/0dd5cc5d425bbb67b558156932d94380da787c34.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42832659/758393bf24c852d8dae4bd45684e8e3e474b97e0.jpg[/img]

A new Darkness Revenge update will be released by the end of the month.
Jill's story goes on.
There will be about 600 new pictures, a dozen animations, about 10000 words and several choices, which, as always, will change the events of the story.
Jill will meet new characters... there will be lots of sex!
As far as Nathan's story is concerned, there will be no new scenes.
I have fixed some narrative bugs that have been reported to me and improved the English (I hope).

notes.title: Darkness Revenge has been updated!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42832659/c522a7bf73c1fd03d9880affde331b702688fc78.jpg[/img]

Darkness Revenge has been updated!
This is the first of three updates that will bring the game to its conclusion.
In this update, Jill's story moves forward:
- The scene at Liam's house is complete.
- Jill takes a trip to Rome with Amanda.
- Jill does combat training with Laura.
- Jill takes revenge on her former boss Sarah.
- 500 new images.
- 12000 words.
- Added music and sound effects to Jill's story.
- 3 new achievements.
- Fixed some minor bugs.
Darkness Revenge remains in early access, so I invite all players who wish to, to share their thoughts and report any inconsistencies or bugs.
Thanks everyone and I hope you enjoy the update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42832659/8e6cd0f1408f9d476c77c6191f44959cf646441e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Darkness Revenge Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.
I am working on an update of Darkness Revenge.
The update will obviously be about Jill's story.
In some scenes you will find Jill with a different makeup and hairstyle. I hope you will like it!
In this update there will be the (currently missing) part of Sarah (Jill's former boss).
Two encounters with Laura (lesbian path).
Two encounters with Amanda (lesbian path).
I will also complete the meeting with Liam.
There will be new achievements.
[b]The update will be released in about 4 weeks.[/b]
Thank you!
